title: Vibe Coding — Task execution (compact + ingest)
description: Hybrid execution workflow: compact ingest, then Plan post-ingest (same contract as default.with-ingest); Review → Deliver use compact phases. Intended for tasks with mostly clear requirements. If AC/scope are still fuzzy, run spec-discovery first. ~7 flat steps plus optional Deliver: Ingest → Plan → Review → Execute (TDD + two-layer) → Verify → Deliver(opt).

steps.title: Ingest spec
steps.notes: Research and scope only — no PLAN.md in this phase. One step → .vibe/research/<task-id>.md; then PLAN.md in the next phase. This ingest is intentionally lightweight and does not replace spec-discovery for unclear requirements.

steps.title: Plan

variants.label: Detailed plan
variants.description: More micro-steps for large tasks (skips duplicate load-spec; ingest already ran).

steps.notes: Build PLAN.md from .vibe/research/<task-id>.md; contract: packages/devkit-hub/docs/technical/PLAN-POST-INGEST-SKILL-REFACTOR.md. Default sub_workflow: phase.plan.post-ingest (no duplicate get_task_context after ingest).

steps.title: Execute
steps.notes: TDD then two-layer review; fetch_knowhow on the implement step per domain slice.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.notes: Minimal handoff when required. optional=true is engine-only: team may still require PR/handoff — document in CONTRIBUTING or devkit.workflow-profile.json (PLAN-VERIFY-DELIVER §1.3).
